technician_brief.body:
What failed: arm-1 elbow_flex (servo ID 3) stalled reaching for the bin. It held at 61 deg against a 92 deg goal with load at 100% for 3.1 s, and the temperature rose from 38 to 47 C. Bus voltage was steady at 11.9 V. The other five servos move normally.

Healer tried: backed off 10 deg and retried slowly twice, and both stalled at the same angle. A move toward home also stalled, so the joint is blocked both ways. It then parked the arm with torque off.

Check first (torque is off):
1. Move the elbow by hand through its full range. Look for an obstruction, a pinched cable or a link rubbing near 61 deg.
2. If it feels gritty or locked, or spins freely with no load, the servo gears or motor have likely failed. Swap in the spare.
3. Reseat the elbow cable and check the horn screws.

A jam fits the evidence as well as a failed servo, so I can't tell which yet.

Part: one C018-12V servo is staged as a spare, pending approval. Use only the 12V C018 variant. Set servo ID to 3 after the swap and recalibrate.
